The '''Corellian militia''' was a military force of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

The [[Militia/Legends|militia]] encompassed the military music bands [[Battling 166th Troubadours]] and [[Fighting 357th Serenaders]]. The [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Grondorn Muse]] was a former member of the Fighting 357th Serenaders<ref name="SWG:GM" /> before joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] blacklisted his [[Music/Legends|music]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Grondorn Muse}}</ref>

[[Myn Donos]] earned his [[Corellian Bloodstripe]]s for his service as a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] in an elite counterinsurgency unit<ref name="XW:WS">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref> of the Corellian militia.<ref name="HG">''[[Hero's Guide]]''</ref>
